description: This file contains a shell script designed to validate WAN IPv4 and IPv6 connectivity by executing ping commands, processing their output, and analyzing packet loss and latency metrics. It includes instructions for prerequisites, commands for IPv4 and optional IPv6 pings, and normalization of output data.

methods.name: R
methods.description: An alias for executing remote commands, defaulting to environment variable CRAM_REMOTE_COMMAND.

calls: R "ping -c 2 -w 4 1.1.1.1 | sed -E 's/time=[0-9\.]+/time=X.Y/g;s/([0-9]+)% packet loss/PL=\1%/g' | grep -E 'icmp_seq=|PL=' | sort | uniq"

R "ping -6 -c 2 -w 6 2606:4700:4700::1111 2>&1 | sed -E 's/time=[0-9\.]+/time=X.Y/g;s/([0-9]+)% packet loss/PL=\1%/g' | grep -E 'icmp_seq=|PL=|Name or service not known|No route to host|Network is unreachable' | sort | uniq"
